turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There are ducklings at the pond near me. They're so tiny and fast.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ducklings are such a treat to photograph. Can you get low, near the water?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sort of, there's a little wooden jetty.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lie on it if you can and shoot along the water. Eye level with the ducklings makes the photos feel like you're in their world.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My shots so far are just fuzzy brown blobs.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Use a fast shutter, at least a five hundredth of a second, and focus on the eye. If the eye is sharp, the rest can be a little soft.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And if mum duck gets angry?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep your distance and use your zoom. If she starts hissing or herding them away, that's your cue to back off.
